services.name: & Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Climb aboard our sunset cruise as you and your private party embark and navigate to the bayside of the island to witness one of the most magical sunsets in the world. Listen to your favorite tunes and sip your worries away as you float through the bay while the last minutes of the Florida Keys sunshine kiss your face. Enjoy a three hour sandbar charter with nonstop fun in the sun. Our Captain will find a perfect spot at the world famous Islamorada sandbar to anchor up while you enjoy the crystal clear water and the hot Florida Sunshine.
